budget.dev_fits: 10 outer x 4 env x 3 inner x 6 candidates x 2 seeds = 1440
budget.gpu_estimate: ~2.5-4 GPU-h (measured 10.2 s per 100-epoch fit at n=485 for B0; B3 x1.7, B4 x2, B5 x3.3)

notes: fold0/env1 test was observed by earlier RR/MoEGP smokes; the same outer folds were used across rounds; results are not an independent confirmation
failures are recorded per fit; any failure => summary is marked INCOMPLETE and macro is omitted
seeds 42/2026: inner early stopping per seed; selection scores the seed-averaged validation prediction; each seed refits with its own median inner epoch budget and a replayed per-seed lr trajectory
no model weights are saved; the test phase refits from the recorded selection

selection_metric: inner_val_pcc; tie (<=1e-12) -> earlier candidate in the pre-registered config order
refit: test phase refits on the full dev; best_epoch is 0-based, recorded refit epochs = ceil(median(best_epoch + 1)), capped
test_contact: one-shot evaluation after refit; no test-based decisions
